name: All
description: Every gecko code in the repo, in one ini, all switched OFF. It is a catalog to pick from in Rio's Gecko Codes list, not a configuration: plenty of these codes contradict each other (three ways to boot, two fielder-select versions, test harnesses), so turning the whole thing on would not survive a boot.
_notes: Both excludes are name collisions with a copy elsewhere in the tree; cgecko
keys an ini entry by name, so shipping both would silently drop one of them.
Boot To Main Menu.asm      -- same gecko name as Global/Boot To Main Menu.c,
which does the same boot skip plus the memory
card load. Ranked builds its own copy anyway.
Skip Memory Card Check.ini -- byte-for-byte the Rio Built-in copy (Rio Built-in/
Skip Memory Card Check on Main Menu.ini) apart
Renaming or deleting either duplicate would let these excludes go away.
